surfaces.scope: whole History surface; see the separately scoped table DOM contract
unresolved_evidence_gaps: The live AMC fragments prove seven-cell DOM and one file-deletion row; they do not prove other file-operation variants, action outcomes, mobile presentation, pagination transitions, focus/hover behavior, or .odate hydration.
Wikijump history actions for a file event resolve to the nearest page snapshot by timestamp; the corresponding Wikidot V/S action outcome is not established by AMC evidence.

surfaces.scope: the observed file-deletion event in the combined page History list: F flag, seven-cell row, V/S affordances, descending event-time placement between page revisions, and shared history ordinal
unresolved_evidence_gaps: The retained live sample proves one file-deletion event. Upload/edit/move row variants and equal-timestamp ordering were not observed, so this certificate must not be widened to those cases.
The V/S action outcomes for file events are not established by the captured AMC response; broader History interactions remain quarantined by page.history.

surfaces.scope: only the observed History table DOM contract: seven ordered cells, row id prefix, from/to radios, flag/action cells, author/date/comment selectors; localization may change visible header/flag text
intentional_differences: Header labels and flag tooltip text are localized while cell order and selectors remain stable.
unresolved_evidence_gaps: The narrow DOM certificate covers the observed seven-cell rows, including one file-deletion row. It does not establish date hydration/visibility, mobile styling, action outcomes, or pager states.
